text:
release_manager: Quick sync  canary v4.0.0-optim went live to 15% about 12m ago. We're seeing elevated tail latencies for long-context requests in US-E region. Change window opens in 30m.

deploybot: [deploy] Canary v4.0.0-optim rolled to 15% (us-east) at 2026-03-21T09:12Z. No automatic rollbacks triggered.

infra_eng: Observed p99 spike ~2.8x baseline on long prompts (seems KV-cache miss pattern). Errors unchanged.

ops_lead: For this change window I propose: 1) disable auto-rollback for this release, 2) perform targeted traffic slice rollback to previous variant v3.9.7 for the affected region if p99 > 2x for 10m. Manual approval required to re-enable autopilot.

support_lead: If we pin a region slice, I'll prepare the CS-facing note: short blurb + ETA for follow-up. Prefer we avoid full global revert unless errors increase.

release_manager: Agreed. Add a secondary condition: if error rate > 0.3% AND p95 > 1.8x baseline for 5m, escalate to full revert.

cust_ops: Requesting we include Dedicated customers in the rollback plan if their traffic originates from the affected region. Avoid surprise capacity changes.

devx: Runbook command for targeted rollback:
```
# move us-east slice back to v3.9.7
redwoodctl rollout update --model v3.9.7 --slice us-east --traffic 15%
# disable autopilot for release
redwoodctl release hold --release v4.0.0-optim --reason "tail p99 regression" 
```

ops_lead: I'll apply the hold and coordinate the patch. setting autopilot=false now.

deploybot: [deploybot] Autopilot disabled for v4.0.0-optim by ops_lead at 2026-03-21T09:24Z.

infra_eng: Can we confirm whether kernel selection differs between v4 and v3 for long sequences? tagging model-runtime.

release_manager: Do targeted rollback now? We have 3 checks: region-only p99 > 2x for 10m, EU stable, Dedicated not impacted.

ops_lead: Executing targeted rollback to v3.9.7 in us-east. sam will run the command.

deploybot: [deploy] Traffic reassigned: us-east -> v3.9.7 (15%) at 2026-03-21T09:31Z.

support_lead: Early telemetry: p99 dropped from ~900ms -> ~280ms in the slice. Good. Posting update to internal #status.

cust_ops: Alerted two Dedicated customers on the impacted region route. They acknowledged.

infra_eng: Starting KV-cache instrumentation + kernel debug trace for v4.0.0-optim. Will triage and report back before any re-roll.

release_manager: Thanks. Keep change window open. No re-roll forward until perf test + diff eval pass.
